page.overview:
Who is Juniper Kim?

Juniper served in the Earth Empire's science division, contributing to the development of General Kuvira's war machines. In the aftermath of Kuvira's siege of Republic City, Juniper wanted to atone by using her talents to heal rather than destroy. She arrived in Republic City and quickly found other scientists looking to use their skills to help those in need. She pitched a project to them: discover peaceful uses of wartime technology to aid Republic City. Her past was not a secret, but she worked behind the scenes, and many were surprised to learn she worked for the Earth Empire. As she was seeking funding, she met Asami Sato, the CEO of Future Industries. Asami saw that Juniper's willingness to make up for past misdeeds was genuine, and the two became friends.

With some pooled funds and pulled strings, Juniper and her team secured an unused building in one of the city's industrial areas and started their work. As interest grew among other innovators and politicians, Juniper got used to explaining how weapons and other technology could be harnessed for tools. However, those who did not share her vision started paying attention to the project as well. The Peace Lily Society opposed the use of technology and weapons invented through the oppression of the Earth Kingdom's people, and started protesting outside Juniper's laboratory for weeks.

Eventually, the canisters were stolen from the laboratory, along with weapons from Kuvira's mech. Juniper arrived one night to find the canisters were gone and the scientists working at the laboratory at the time were knocked out. Asami used her resources to help Juniper to keep all protesters and reporters at bay, as the scientist had no experience dealing with the press and the theft could turn out to be a PR disaster.

Juniper wanted to help the world struggling through the use of technology. She was ashamed of working on Kuvira's war machines, and ever since fleeing the Earth Empire she tried to use her skills for good. She was always anxious about what people thought of her upon learning that she worked on the weapon that caused so much pain and suffering. Juniper was primarily driven to atone for her past and could be overcome with guilt.
